summary: Independently audited the fair-D4 reference policy: verified full-width four-ply search, determinism, reflection safety, public-state-only inputs and provably non-binding work and cache bounds, and identified an uncalibrated terminal utility, a five-stratum estimator that cannot represent the seven-atom disc distribution, a manifest provenance gap, and a horizon that misses the row rise on a fifth of decisions.
validationPerformed: Rebuilt the reference with the Makefile's exact flags and confirmed the binary is byte-identical to the committed one.
Confirmed all four audited source hashes match research/benchmarks/baselines-v1.json.
Measured stratum coverage over 4M draws and re-derived the worst-case work and cache bounds by hand.
limitations: Recorded by the coordinator on the delegated agent's behalf; the agent had no write access to research/ and did not review this transcription.
Read-only audit; strength numbers remain ledger-recorded and not independently replicated.
